name: Samsung Galaxy A37 5G (Demo Unit)
shortDescription: Open-box demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy A37 5G. It has a 17.01 cm (6.7 inch) 120 Hz Super AMOLED display, 50 MP OIS camera, 5,000 mAh battery and IP68 rating.
description:
This is a demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy A37 5G that was used for in-store demonstration, sold open-box at a lower price. It may show light signs of handling. Please contact us before ordering if you'd like to know its exact condition, the accessories included and the remaining manufacturer warranty.

The Samsung Galaxy A37 5G has a 17.01 cm (6.7 inch) FHD+ Super AMOLED display with a refresh rate of up to 120 Hz. It has an octa-core processor (2.75 GHz + 2 GHz) with 8 GB or 12 GB RAM and 128 GB or 256 GB storage.

There are three rear cameras (50 MP with OIS, 8 MP and 5 MP) and a 12 MP front camera, with 4K video recording and stereo speakers. The phone has a 5,000 mAh battery (typical), NFC, Wi-Fi 802.11 ax, Corning Gorilla Glass Victus+ on the front and back, and an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.

Samsung lists up to 6 OS upgrades for this model, with security updates until 31 March 2032.
